surfaces.label: Contingency-table tests, measures, diagnostics, and chart data
surfaces.boundary: The exact package pin declares 39 focused numerical tools through the local statistics server.

surfaces.label: Versioned methods and limitations
surfaces.boundary: The exact package pin declares two evidence resources through the local statistics server.

surfaces.label: Local CSV, TSV, XLSX, SAV, and inline-record import
surfaces.boundary: The headless server imports supported respondent files and verified full-data project packages into new local copies within bounded workload limits; package audit history is not imported as trusted local history.

surfaces.label: Assumption-aware, evidence-linked survey analysis guidance
surfaces.boundary: The shared skill requires bases, assumptions, effect sizes, multiplicity status, limitations, and non-causal wording.

surfaces.label: Saved filters, row sets, weights, survey designs, multibanners, ordering, and export recipes
surfaces.boundary: The local headless bundle uses versioned project revisions, idempotency keys, audit events, approved dictionary edits, and proposal/review/apply/undo transformations.

surfaces.label: Significance letters and approved complex-survey designs
surfaces.boundary: Tables and tab books include supported significance diagnostics and canonical aggregate widgets; design-aware OLS, logistic, and K-means methods require explicit supported survey designs and retain method-specific limitations.

surfaces.label: Editable PPTX/DOCX generation and refresh
surfaces.boundary: The local headless server generates editable report packs and refreshes compatible generated regions without overwriting the source package.

surfaces.label: Replacement waves, schema-drift detection and repair, and wave comparison
surfaces.boundary: The local headless server preserves prior waves, previews repairs, applies approved reversible operations, and compares compatible tables.

surfaces.label: On-device project execution
surfaces.boundary: The plugin uses local stdio processes and user-controlled storage. Local JSON persistence enforces 8 MiB per serialized project including audit/undo and 32 MiB per combined database including replay; these are not row-count, memory, or compute guarantees. Source publication is separate from package, Registry, and directory status.
